$comment: 絵の台帳（docs/rendering-requirements.md §4.1 の2）。create-tiles-pro は1回で組（草の4種、道路のつながり方18通り）を作るので、キーは組の名前にする。heightTiles は基準タイルの幅を1とした絵の高さ。body はそのまま API に送り、refs は art/sprites/<tw>/<キー>.png を参照画像として差し込む。
style: isometric pixel art in the style of a cozy city-building game, 2:1 dimetric projection, crisp single-pixel lines, light from the top-left so the right-facing wall is darker, selective outline (outline colors follow the face colors, no black outline), limited palette, no text, no letters, transparent background

sprites.description: 1). short green grass 2). green grass with a few tiny white and yellow flowers 3). green grass with small clover patches 4). slightly darker green grass with a few longer blades. Calm, even colors so that tiles repeat seamlessly; no rocks, no paths, no objects
paved grey asphalt city road with a dashed white center line and light grey curbs, on green grass

small two-storey wooden house, red pitched roof, cream wooden walls, small windows and a door on the left face, the building stands directly on the ground with no base platform, no dirt slab and no grass patch under it, the bottom of the walls follows a 2:1 diamond footprint that spans the full width of the canvas, nothing else around it

small covered market hall, blue and white striped awnings over open stalls with fruit crates, light stone walls, the building stands directly on the ground with no base platform, no dirt slab and no grass patch under it, the bottom of the walls follows a 2:1 diamond footprint that spans the full width of the canvas, nothing else around it

small brick factory, grey saw-tooth roof with yellow trim, one tall chimney, loading door on the left face, the building stands directly on the ground with no base platform, no dirt slab and no grass patch under it, the bottom of the walls follows a 2:1 diamond footprint that spans the full width of the canvas, nothing else around it
